subject: [NAME] - ML Ops
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on your new role as Director of ML at [COMPANY], great achievement!

I've been digging into ML workflows in medtech, especially around
expert-labeled EEG data, QA, and edge-case handling, and wanted to reach
out. My team at Encord works with Viz.ai, Mayo Clinic, Floy, and others to
streamline multimodal data pipelines.

For context, the Encord platform supports everything from curation to
annotation, active learning, and model eval. I'd love to hear how you're
approaching labeling quality and model iteration as you plan for [YEAR], and
share insights from similar teams tackling high-stakes, real-time clinical
ML workflows.

Would you have 20 min next week (Wed/Thu) for a quick virtual coffee? I'm
happy to work around your schedule.

weeks - happy to share how we've helped similar teams
